groups.name: color
groups.description: The raw palette, in steps from light (50) to dark (900). Designs use Semantic tokens, which point here.

groups.name: gray
groups.description: Neutrals: text, surfaces and borders.

groups.name: brand
groups.description: Optics indigo: primary actions, selection and focus.

groups.name: red
groups.description: Critical: errors and destructive actions.

groups.name: green
groups.description: Success.

groups.name: orange
groups.description: Warning: something needs attention soon.

groups.name: yellow
groups.description: Caution: worth knowing, not urgent.

groups.name: azure
groups.description: Info.

groups.name: purple
groups.description: Magic: suggestions and AI.

groups.name: alpha
groups.description: Colors with opacity: overlays, hover washes and shadows.

groups.name: space
groups.description: Spacing on a 4px grid: the step is in hundredths of 4px (100 = 4px, 400 = 16px).

groups.name: font
groups.description: Type primitives. The Typography collection combines them into text styles.

groups.name: size
groups.description: Font sizes in px; the step is in hundredths of 4px (350 = 14px).

groups.name: line-height
groups.description: Line heights in percent of the font size.

groups.name: radius
groups.description: Corner radii; the step is in hundredths of 4px (200 = 8px).

groups.name: motion
groups.description: How things move: durations and easing curves.

groups.name: duration
groups.description: Short for small changes (hover), longer for big ones (a dialog opening).

groups.name: bg
groups.description: Backgrounds: the page, surfaces on it, and fills for controls.

groups.name: surface
groups.description: Cards, panels and inputs: what content sits on.

groups.name: fill
groups.description: Fills for controls: buttons, badges, checkboxes.

groups.name: text
groups.description: Text, by role.

groups.name: border
groups.description: Borders and dividers.

groups.name: icon
groups.description: Icons, by role.

groups.name: shadow
groups.description: Elevation: 100 sits on the page, 600 floats above everything. Darker in Dark mode, where light shadows don’t show.

variables.name: bg/surface/secondary
variables.description: A surface set back from the default one.

variables.name: bg/surface/inverse
variables.description: Tooltips and toasts: the opposite of the page.

variables.name: bg/fill/transparent
variables.description: Tertiary and plain buttons: no fill until hovered.

variables.name: text/on-fill
variables.description: Text on brand and critical fills.

variables.name: text/critical

variables.description: Text for warning messages, on their tinted surface or the default one.

variables.description: Text for caution messages, on their tinted surface or the default one.

variables.name: text/info
variables.description: Text for info messages, on their tinted surface or the default one.

variables.name: text/magic
variables.description: Text for magic messages, on their tinted surface or the default one.
